stories.title: AI Leaders Call For Slowdown; Dow Futures Track AI Stocks
stories.summary: AI leaders — Anthropic's Dario Amodei, OpenAI's Sam Altman, and SpaceX's Elon Musk — called for a slowdown in AI development, according to a Yahoo Finance report on Dow Jones futures. The report says AI stocks are in focus as futures traders react to the comments. Further detail on the specific proposal is not given in the source.
stories.whyItMatters: AI stocks have driven much of the market's recent gains, so comments from top AI executives can shift sentiment quickly.
